description: Per-pitch string physics (the FDTD string model) as served by GET /get_parameter/string.

domains.title: String physics
domains.write: param.set {parameter: string, key_no, values} (values = {pitch: {field: value}}, the GET shape; REST_API also documents the alias parameter name 'physics')
domains.key_space: piano pitch (the preset's key range, e.g. 23..106); output pitches 128+ are rejected 416
domains.shape: {field: value} per pitch; length in metres
domains.stored_vs_effective: Fields are stored per pitch; tail is DERIVED (= length/10), never independently stored, and re-derived on a length edit (Data Model Card). Physics edits change the level by physics and are kept as heard: they do NOT clear output_scale_calibrated (Layer B edit policy). A string edit is checked against the FDTD CFL bound; how a breach is handled is a doc conflict (see _index.json doc_conflicts).

fields.name: length
fields.range: finite (NaN/Inf rejected 400); no other documented bound
fields.meaning: Main-section (speaking) physical length; a POSTed value is interpreted as metres and re-derives dx and tail; length up -> pitch down.

fields.name: tail
fields.units: UNKNOWN (the Data Model Card gives tail = length/10; PARAMETER_SYSTEM slot 1 calls the engine value a tail point count)
fields.meaning: Derived tail section (= length/10), read-only: never independently stored.

fields.name: tension
fields.range: finite; must keep the FDTD amplification max|g| <= 1 (two-sided box 8*coeff_bending <= coeff_tension <= 1 + 8*coeff_bending)
fields.meaning: String tension T; f0 rises as sqrt(T); raising it raises coeff_tension and the CFL ratio (check stability_ratio first).

fields.name: rho
fields.range: finite; part of the CFL combination check
fields.meaning: Linear (per-unit-length) density; rho up -> f0 down; in the physical string-gain model it also feeds the excitation coefficient G = R/(rho*dx^2).

fields.name: r
fields.range: finite; part of the CFL combination check (bending stiffness scales with r^4)
fields.meaning: String radius; r up -> inharmonicity B up (B scales with r^4); tightens the CFL bound through coeff_bending.

fields.name: jung
fields.units: UNKNOWN (documented as a Young's modulus coefficient, no unit stated)
fields.range: finite; part of the CFL combination check; the Belarus preset stores it negative (SYNTHESIS_ENGINE)
fields.meaning: Young's modulus coefficient E of the bending-stiffness term; E up -> inharmonicity B up.

fields.name: gamma
fields.units: UNKNOWN (viscous / velocity damping coefficient; dt-scaled in the engine)
fields.range: finite; no other documented bound (velocity damping does not change the CFL bound)
fields.meaning: Velocity damping gamma of the string PDE; gamma up -> decay time tau down (shorter sustain).

fields.name: dispersion_damping
fields.units: UNKNOWN (per-sub-step effect at the reference grid 48 kHz x 4; the engine applies x dt/dt_ref)
fields.range: finite; raising it TIGHTENS the CFL bound
fields.meaning: Frequency-dependent (HF) damping gamma_HF (model name disp_decay, engine slot frequency_damping); up -> faster high-frequency decay.

fields.name: detuning
fields.meaning: Per-string tension detuning step (model name tension_offset) for the chorus effect of multi-string unisons; up -> beat rate up; honoured by the CFL check per string.

fields.name: damper_string
fields.units: UNKNOWN (per-sub-step effect at the reference grid 48 kHz x 4)
fields.meaning: Damper coefficient on the string, multiplied by the damper step count (18 closed, 0 open while the key is held); up -> shorter release.

fields.name: damper_tail
fields.meaning: Tail damper: tail decrement = damper_string * damper_tail; stock presets store damper_tail == damper_string, so it is near-inert until set as a multiplier (e.g. 127).
